name: career-os
description: Open-source AI-powered career operating system for students, professionals, and lifelong learners

scripts.dev: node api.js && concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: node api.js && npm --prefix backend run dev
scripts.dev:frontend: node api.js && npm --prefix frontend run dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.start: node api.js && concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:backend: node api.js && npm --prefix backend run start
scripts.start:frontend: node api.js && npm --prefix frontend run preview

author: BugBaar Community
